output.title: Command injection via shell=True
output.exploit_story: An attacker who controls the command string gains arbitrary command execution on the server.
output.remediation: Pass the command as an argument list without shell=True and validate all inputs.

output.title: Unsafe eval of dynamic input
output.exploit_story: Untrusted data passed to eval can execute arbitrary code in the process.
output.remediation: Replace eval with a safe parser or a whitelist of allowed operations.

output.title: Hardcoded password in source
output.exploit_story: Anyone with repository read access obtains the database password without brute-forcing.
output.remediation: Move the secret to an environment variable or secret manager and rotate it.

output.title: Unsafe pickle deserialization
output.exploit_story: A crafted pickle payload can run arbitrary code when deserialized.
output.remediation: Use a safe serialization format such as JSON, or verify the payload signature.

output.title: SQL injection via string concatenation
output.exploit_story: An attacker injects SQL through the user_id parameter, reading or deleting arbitrary rows.
output.remediation: Use parameterized queries instead of building SQL with string interpolation.

output.title: Path traversal in file download
output.exploit_story: An attacker uses ../ sequences to read arbitrary files from the server.
output.remediation: Resolve the path and verify it stays inside the allowed directory.

output.title: XXE via insecure XML parser
output.exploit_story: A malicious XML document reads local files or makes internal network requests.
output.remediation: Disable external entities and DTD loading in the XML parser.

output.title: Command injection via os.system
output.exploit_story: Shell metacharacters in the deployment tag execute arbitrary commands as the service user.
output.remediation: Use subprocess with an argument list and never pass unsanitized input to a shell.

output.title: Unsafe yaml.load
output.exploit_story: A crafted YAML file can construct arbitrary Python objects during loading.

output.title: Server-side template injection
output.exploit_story: User-controlled template text evaluates Jinja2 expressions with server access.
output.remediation: Never pass untrusted input to render_template_string; escape it first.

output.title: TLS verification disabled
output.exploit_story: Traffic to the third-party API can be intercepted in transit by a network attacker.
output.remediation: Remove verify=False so certificates are validated.

output.title: JWT signed with hardcoded secret
output.exploit_story: An attacker who reads the source forges admin tokens for any user.
output.remediation: Load the signing secret from an environment variable and rotate it.
